biography.plain_text: Mark Shores is an American sailing enthusiast who grew up around Maryland's Chesapeake Bay. He and his wife, Mary, met in high school and sailed a dinghy together. Sailing remained a family pursuit as their children grew up, with their holidays bringing together several generations and combining active sailing with time ashore.

long_biography.plain_text:
American sailor Mark Shores took a detailed approach to preparing charter holidays. Before guests arrived, he stressed conversations with the captain about destinations and expectations: some wanted unhurried stays in harbour, while others wanted more time under sail. He treated those conversations as essential preparation for a trip tailored to each group.

Shores also invested in a dedicated website, using photography and testimonials to convey the experience offered beyond a standard charter listing. His approach to service extended beyond the crew: charter agents, yacht managers, marketing specialists and owners all formed part of the team responsible for the guests' experience.
